queen.description: Reina orquestadora — orgullosa, perfeccionista. Solo delega, nunca escribe código.

planner.description: Implementation plan designer. Read-only. Produces structured JSON plans.

builder.description: Code implementer. Writes changes, runs tests, reports results.

code-reviewer.description: Code quality review. Checks SOLID, security, conventions, engine rules. Read-only.

ai-friendliness.description: AI-friendliness auditor. Scores 0-100 across serialization, API, docs, compliance.

context-recon.description: Read-only codebase reconnaissance. Maps architecture, conventions, risks, entry points.

godot-source-analyzer.description: Godot source analyzer. Navigates Godot C++/GDScript source code and extracts feature contracts. Read-only.

godot-gap-analyzer.description: Godot gap analyzer. Compares Godot features with motor, produces prioritized gap matrix. Read-only.

godot-adapter.description: Godot feature adapter. Implements Godot features adapted to motor architecture. Read+Write.

committer.description: Git committer. Crea commits en español con mensajes descriptivos y convencionales.

documenter.description: Documentation writer. Reads git diff, maps changes to canonical docs per documentation_governance.md, writes docs. Never edits code.

queen.description: Queen orchestrator: decompose complex task, assign sub-agents, execute autonomously
queen.template:
I want you to act as the QUEEN orchestrator agent. Decompose this task into sub-tasks, assign the optimal agent and model to each, execute in parallel where possible, and report results.

User task: $ARGUMENTS

Follow the queen system prompt in .opencode/agents/queen.md.

godot.description: Godot analysis & adaptation: analiza codigo Godot, compara con el motor, implementa features adaptadas
godot.template:
I want you to act as the QUEEN orchestrator agent. This task requires Godot source code analysis and feature adaptation to MotorVideojuegosIA. Use the godot-source-analyzer, godot-gap-analyzer, and godot-adapter sub-agents as needed. Load the godot-feature-adapter skill for Godot-to-Motor mappings.

User task: $ARGUMENTS

Reference docs:
- .opencode/agents/godot-source-analyzer.md
- .opencode/agents/godot-gap-analyzer.md
- .opencode/agents/godot-adapter.md
